blocks.title: Read a repository instead of guessing about it
blocks.description: Zread answers from a GitHub repository's own documentation, structure and source files. It needs a Z.ai API key from a GLM Coding Plan.

showcase.assistant_reply: I'll read its docs first, then the files that actually define logging.

blocks.title: What you can ask Astravia to do

items.title: Search a repository's docs
items.description: Ask what a project does, how to run it, what the core modules are, or what changed in recent commits and issues.

items.title: See the layout first
items.description: Ask for the structure of the repository or one subdirectory before deciding which file is worth opening.

items.title: Open one file in full
items.description: Read a single file's whole content to check an implementation, follow a refactor, or review a change.

items.title: Get a key from a GLM Coding Plan
items.description: Zread is open to Coding Plan subscribers only and is billed per request. Create the key in the Z.ai console and check your quota there.

items.title: Install this Ability in Astravia
items.description: Enter the key itself when prompted; the connection adds the Bearer prefix. Name the repository as owner/name in your prompt.

items.title: Ask a question that names the repository
items.description: For example: find the module that handles X in owner/repo and show the file that implements it.

blocks.title: Hosted service, metered per request
blocks.content: Zread is a hosted service. Tool inputs, including repository names, paths and search terms, are sent to api.z.ai over HTTPS. Usage is billed by request against your Coding Plan, not by this listing. Without a valid key the connection fails to authenticate.

The three tools are `search_doc`, `get_repo_structure` and `read_file`. The repository must be reachable by the service; private repositories are not covered by this connection. Never paste an API key into a chat prompt or a shared log.
Zread is provided by Z.ai (Zhipu AI). The Astravia marketplace listing is maintained by Astravia.
